# @adobe/spectrum-diff-core

> Shared core library for Spectrum diff generation tools (tokens, component schemas, etc.)

Shared core library for Spectrum diff generation tools (tokens, component schemas, etc.).

## Install

`npm install @adobe/spectrum-diff-core`
